Subject: Q4 coverage stress test — verify commits & remediation plan

Team —

Finance asked us to run a quick stress test on coverage for Q4 (target: 3.0x). I attached a flattened sheet with current pipe-to-quota by segment. Can each of you do the following by EOD today?

- Marissa: refresh the Stage/Commit flags for all deals > $50k and call out any deals you moved from Commit -> Commit (Staged) or vice versa.
- Ben: reconcile weighted ARR vs. legal readiness (are POs / SOWs pending?). Flag any procurement blockers.
- Karthik: sanity-check expected close calendar (are there dependencies we should not assume in-week-of 12/11?).

I want a one-line status per top-10 deal and a recommended remediation (e.g., push to reserve, convert to late-stage upside, or escalate to AE+CS). If anything looks like it will slip past Dec 31, mark it.

Attachments: Q4-commit-sheet.xlsx (flattened exports)

Thanks — naive heatmap will get routed to Finance after your updates.

—Naomi
